about.title: About Fabia Converter
about.intro: Škoda Fabia Converter is the world's first unit converter that measures everything in Škoda Fabias — standardized on the Škoda Fabia 1.2 HTP. This unique tool takes any physical measurement and tells you how many Fabias it equals.
about.systemVolume: Volume: Hot tub = ~20 Fabia fuel tanks
about.whyRelatable: Relatable Scale: Everyone can visualize a car-sized reference
about.whyFun: Fun & Memorable: Makes measurements more engaging
about.whyUniversal: Universal Reference: The Fabia is known worldwide
about.whyPractical: Practical Dimensions: Perfect human-scale reference point
about.featureAi: Smart AI Processing: Uses OpenAI's GPT models for accurate Fabia-based conversions
about.featureMultilingual: Multilingual Support: Supports 8 languages including Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, and more
about.featureFast: Lightning Fast: Smart caching system reduces response times to under 100ms
about.featureMobile: Mobile Ready: Progressive Web App (PWA) that works offline
about.featureEmbed: Embeddable: Share your Fabia measurements anywhere
about.techBackend: Backend: Cloudflare Workers with Hono framework
about.techAi: AI: OpenAI GPT-5 mini by default (with GPT-4 family options)

help.title: Help & Tips
help.howTo1: Enter your conversion request in natural language
help.howTo2: Select your preferred language for the response
help.howTo3: Choose an explanation style (Funny or Scientific)
help.example5: "1000 liters" → How many Fabia fuel tanks
help.example6: "1 hectare" → How many Fabia parking spaces
help.tip1: Just enter the measurement - no need to specify target units
help.tip2: Include units (m², kg, kW, liters, etc.)
help.tip4: Try different physical quantities: area, weight, power, volume
help.tip5: Ask for explanations to understand the Fabia comparison
